defects.summary: AI consultation failed for any realistic show: the browser built a 120-line/80-cue context with no size budget, but /api/agent/interpret rejects contexts over 15000 JSON chars with INVALID_INPUT (120 lines + 30 cues = 15613 chars). When accepted, Muse only saw a window around the selected cue or L1, so lines/cues named in the instruction were missing.
defects.repro: test/agentRoutes.test.mjs realistic-size route test returned 400; tools/runq-context-retrieval-eval.mjs A_LEGACY_WINDOW: server accepts 50%, usable evidence 0% at 1200 and 3000 lines.
defects.fix: src/core/agentCore.mjs buildAgentContext enforces AGENT_CONTEXT_MAX_CHARS (shared with tools/agentRoutes.mjs) and keeps a third of it for script: it omits empty cue fields and unreferenced assets, then the details (not the identity) of cues far from the focus/evidence (detailsOmitted), and drops whole cues only as a last resort, never the selected one (otherwise the UI blocked with a false 80-cue error). Lines are filled by priority: L# refs, cue N / selected-cue source lines with preceding dialogue, IDF-weighted instruction keywords, then the focus window; original text is verbatim. src/ui/runq-agent-ui.mjs passes the instruction and reports the real cue count.
defects.reevaluation: agentCore/agentRoutes 25/25 (4 new red->green, incl. 80 cues with long stage-manager notes). Offline A/B tools/runq-context-retrieval-eval.mjs, 2400 cases x 3 variants, ES/EN, 80-3000 lines, 20% long notes: legacy server acceptance 43.6% / usable evidence 33.2% (0% at 1200+ lines) -> retrieval 100% / 92.0%, UI blocks 0%; LINE/CUE/SELECTED and literal or shared-noun keywords 100%. Known limit kept visible: synonym-only phrasing 44.1% (lexical retrieval). Measures evidence availability, not Muse answer quality.

defects.area: Approved idea -> English SFX prompt fidelity
defects.summary: prepareCueSoundDraft silently dropped approved descriptors the deterministic compiler does not model (tempo, texture, material, place): 'tres toques claros de campana de faro' -> 'A bell...' (lost clear, lighthouse); 'pasos lentos sobre madera vieja que cruje' lost slow/wood/old/creak; English ideas lost words too. The lab still said 'English prompt prepared'.
defects.repro: Journey finding SOUND_PROMPT_DROPS_APPROVED_DETAIL (INFO) in 20/120 journeys; red test test/soundPromptCompiler.test.mjs 'approved cue details survive compilation...'.
defects.fix: src/core/soundPromptCompiler.mjs approvedDetailCoverage(): content words of the approved idea minus stop/operational words and capitalised character names; Spanish words resolved via a general sound-design lexicon (~480 entries, idioms such as 'de golpe', plural/feminine/gerund/participle/-mente/infinitive+se morphology), English words carried verbatim. prepareCueSoundDraft appends 'Approved cue detail to preserve: ...' and returns untranslatedDetail; idea-independent boilerplate ('Dry theatrical sound effect') is not counted as coverage. No cognate guessing: unknown words are surfaced, never invented. src/sfx/lab.mjs shows 'revisa el prompt: falta en ingles <words>' instead of 'prompt preparado en ingles'. tools/runq-journeys-e2e.mjs now measures coverage (P2 if a translatable detail is missing or an untranslated one is hidden).
defects.reevaluation: soundPromptCompiler 47/47 (1 new red->green test with 20+ assertions incl. false-alarm and precision regressions). Seminar stage directions: false 'untranslated' alarms 8/8 -> 0/8 compiled ideas. Unseen-vocabulary held-out set (30 new ideas, written after the lexicon froze): 12/13 compiled ideas flagged before idiom/morphology fixes, 9/13 after; 0 silent drops in all sets. Browser full-show journeys (beginner, ES+EN, 10/10 PASS): SOUND_PROMPT_DROPS 5/5 ES -> 0/10, new coverage check passes. Residual limit: closed lexicon, so unknown nouns still need manual English (UI tells the user).

defects.area: SFX prompt compiler: source vs. place
defects.summary: A source noun used as a place became the generated sound: 'un teléfono suena detrás de la puerta' -> 'A wooden door moves once without a described action' (telephone only appended as detail), 'pasos tras la puerta' -> door, 'un disparo detrás de la puerta' -> door, 'un gato maúlla detrás de la puerta' -> door. The first lexicon match in array order won, so the wrong sound would be sent to Modal.
defects.repro: Found while probing D16 coverage; red test test/soundPromptCompiler.test.mjs 'a source named only as a place does not replace the sound that happens there'.
defects.fix: compileDetection() demotes a source introduced by a locative/motion complement (detrás de, junto a, tras, hacia, desde, se acercan a...). If every source is locative the clause is silent unless the object is acted on (abre/cierra/golpe/chirría/llaman/rompe), so 'corre a la puerta y la abre' still opens the door and 'llaman a la puerta' still knocks. An unparsed idea falls back to the quoted CUE_BRIEF instead of an invented door.
defects.reevaluation: 18 handcrafted boundary sentences: 9 wrong door/none outputs corrected (telephone, footsteps, gunshot, rain, generic noise, cat -> CUE_BRIEF), 0 regressions after the acted-on-object rule (the first draft regressed 3 door/window openings and was revised). 267 corpus lines (12 scripts) compiled with old vs new: 0 changes attributable to D17.

defects.area: SFX prompt compiler: Spanish singular nouns
defects.summary: Lexicon patterns written as 'relojes?' / 'explosiones?' / 'cristales?' require the plural stem, so consonant-final singulars never matched: 'Se oye una explosión' -> 'unspecified stage sound', 'Se rompe un cristal' / 'Se cierra el portón' / 'Pasa un camión' / 'Un rumor de gente' -> no proposal, while the plurals worked. Same for reloj, jarrón, tacón, voz, canción, vals, violín and the spaces corredor, jardín, catedral, hangar. 'El reloj da las doce' was never recognised as a chime.
defects.repro: Static scan of every lexicon regex for stem+'es?' alternatives whose singular cannot match; red test 'singular nouns ending in a consonant reach the same source and space as their plural'.
defects.fix: Patterns rewritten as stem(?:es)? (and voz|voces); the chime action accepts 'da la una' / 'da las dos..doce'. Reaching 'reloj' exposed a prop over-generation also present for the plural ('un reloj de utilería', 'un reloj roto'): a clock now needs a sounding verb (campanada, suena, empieza, continúa) or 'se oye', as windows and mirrors already did.
defects.reevaluation: 20-sentence singular/plural probe: singulars now match their plural's source and space. 267 corpus lines old vs new: 4 changes. The 2 forbidden prop lines the first draft newly fired (reloj de utilería, reloj roto) are silent again after the prop rule. Residual: dialogue lines naming 'explosión' ('Recuerdo una explosión') compile when compiled directly, exactly as plurals did before; the product scan skips dialogue and the Sound Lab compiles only operator-pasted fragments behind explicit authorization.
